name: fieldtrip-linkedin-tracker
description: Fieldtrip webinar-lead LinkedIn tracker. Reads the shared Webinar Leads Notion page, then checks your LinkedIn inbox (read-only) for conversations with anyone on its lead lists. Marks who connected and replied, @mentions you on new replies, and logs the run. If a lead list has only the raw export, it finds LinkedIn URLs with ColdIQ (after asking) and builds HeyReach-ready CSVs. Never sends anything on LinkedIn.
